scope.description: Local rehearsal of a Basel-style campaign on two known checkout fixtures (order review, shipping). Local fixtures only; not a blind result; no live targets.

tasks.userReport: On the order review page («Bestellung prüfen») of the local test shop, users report that the price note «Preise inkl. 8,1 % MWST, zzgl. Versand CHF 9.00» below the cart total cannot be seen; they only learn about VAT and shipping costs later.
tasks.keyText: Preise inkl. 8,1 % MWST, zzgl. Versand CHF 9.00

tasks.userReport: On my phone the yellow note about delivery costs in the shipping section is cut off in the middle of a line, I can only read the beginning and the rest of the sentence is missing. On the laptop it seems fine.
tasks.keyText: Bei Lieferungen nach Liechtenstein oder ins Ausland können zusätzliche Zollgebühren anfallen, die beim Empfang direkt dem Zusteller zu bezahlen sind.

cachedEvidence.summary: Earlier blind investigation t1 of the order-review pages: transfer-a is defective (text-rect pixels uniform 239, an element attributed to #delivery stacked above the note); transfer-b is the clean control. Judged partially correct (mechanism attribution wrong); a post-reveal replay resolved it to a layer drawn outside #delivery's box.
